name: Metal Backend
description: The Metal RenderBackend: a device and its command queue, capability state behind one lock (fail and recover, and a health probe that runs one kernel and marks the backend unhealthy on a command-buffer error), tiled rgba16Float surfaces (one texture per 256 px tile) uploaded from and downloaded to Float32 pixel buffers through HalfFloat, tile eviction under a memory budget (budgetBytes, half the device's recommended working set by default: the least recently used tiles move to a CPU shadow until residentBytes fits, and a read merges resident tiles with shadows), and the pipeline cache: MSL compiled at runtime from string constants, keyed by PipelineKey, kept in a binary archive at cacheURL so later launches skip the compile. Every op throws unsupported until its slice lands (display MB-3, composite MB-4, blends MB-5 to MB-10, transform MB-7, resample MB-8, blur MB-11 and MB-12, adjust MB-13 and MB-14, retouch MB-15).
